verdicts: Exact-stream equality is the strong result and it held on every request pair measured.
Live speed half: combined 18.37 tok/s for gemv and 16.95 tok/s for gemm, a -7.7% prefill throughput change at this prompt/posture.
Speed half reads as 'no consistent throughput win for either route at Q8_0' rather than a settled ordering.
Resolved row width is unchanged by kernel selection: a ~1760-token window splits into ceil(1760/32)=55 weight sub-batches on both routes.
